conbody.p: When the rear bumper around the rear-side radar or sensor is covered with foreign material, such as snow or rain, or installing a trailer or carrier, it can reduce the detecting performance and temporarily limit or disable Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist.
If this occurs, the warning message will appear on the cluster.

p.uicontrol: Driver assistance system limited. Radar blocked.

conbody.p: Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist will operate properly when such foreign material or trailer, etc., is removed.

If Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist does not operate properly after it is removed, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

li.p: Even though the warning message does not appear on the cluster, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist may not operate properly.

Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist may not operate properly if the detection sensor is contaminated or there are no objects around vehicle (such as in an open, unobstructed area), after turning ON the vehicle.

note.p: Turn off Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist to install or remove a trailer, carrier, or another attachment. Turn on Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist when finished.

conbody.p: You can check it in the service message of the utility information view of the cluster display window.
